_comment: Canonical memory control plane only (l9-graphite-memory, MemoryService over stdio). Renders when ${L9_MEMORY_INTERPRETER} names a Python carrying the pinned l9-graphite-memory package (ops/config/memory-binding.json). No env block, no credential value. The legacy direct-provider front door (graphiti-memory over a provider URL) was retired at realignment stage C7/C8; the capability broker never shipped. Peer of environment/agents/adapters/claude-code/mcp.template.json.
